wildebeest.title: Wildebeest Crossing Safari
activities: Day 1: Drive from Kisumu to Masai Mara through scenic tea plantations, arrive for lunch and enjoy an evening game drive.
Day 2: Full-day game drive from 6:00 AM to 4:30 PM with picnic lunch inside the park.
Day 3: Early morning sunrise walk, Maasai culture experience, then drive back to Kisumu.
included: Transportation in a 4×4 Safari Land Cruiser
2 park entry fees to Masai Mara National Reserve

nakuru.title: Lake Nakuru Overnight Safari
activities: Day 1: Departure from Kisumu and journey to Lake Nakuru National Park.
Game viewing and exploration of the park.
Overnight stay at Buraha Zenoni on full board.
Day 2: Morning activities, photography and return journey to Kisumu.
included: Lake Nakuru National Park entry fee
